purpose: Wave-0 encoding contract; cryptographic accept vectors remain wave-1 work

encoding.integer: unsigned big endian, width specified by each layout
encoding.hex: lowercase, exactly twice the raw byte length
encoding.option_digest: 00 for absent; 01 followed by 32 raw bytes for present
encoding.text: BE32 UTF-8 byte length followed by exact UTF-8 bytes
encoding.json_names: Rust field names; frame bodies have a type key FACE, SEENYOU, HANDSHAKE or BLOOM
encoding.json_order: UTF-16 sorted keys, compact JSON, integer frame fields, no duplicate keys
encoding.required_layers: one byte: sound bit 0, motion bit 1, intent_ack bit 2; other bits zero
transcript_preimage: each exact FACE or SEENYOU signed envelope prefixed by its BE32 byte length, in exchange order
encoding.signature: P-256 ECDSA with SHA-256 over the 32 digest bytes as message, P1363 r||s

attempt_rule: Reserve before any decode or verification; finish durably on accept, refuse or abandon; replayed accepted receipts refuse
